symbols.note: copied by hand from gatekit symbols system --dll dx11 (addresses are bg3_dx11.exe). Methods with null address were listed by the Toolkit but the tool printed no game address for them. System index variable bg3_dx11.exe+0x60D978C; the game functions using the index are in the Toolkit line of the tool output. The does layer cites EoCServer.dll (Toolkit pseudo-code with real names) wherever bg3_dx11.exe functions were not individually mapped.
symbols.limits: reads/writes: the component views in the parameters of the system's exported methods. uses: the component operations (add, remove, get, has) its per-frame update performs through the engine's out-of-line helpers, itself or in a function it calls (depth 2), with the call site; kind index: a matched method reads the type's index and the operation is not known. Not listed: operations the compiler inlined, those deeper than depth 2, and what a method that is not the update does (e.g. a SystemLoad) - read its pseudo-code; an empty writes list is not "writes nothing".

does.text: Reads GameStateUnloadSessionComponent, runs ProcessUnloadSession, then destroys through the deferred command buffer every entity in a list it gathered. That these are the inventories of the unloading session is from the names (ProcessUnloadSession, DestroyUnloadedInventories); which entities the list holds was not read.
does.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0xF0BAB0 read: ProcessUnloadSession call, then a DestroyEntity loop
